The dimension 1 at each weight is a statement about the tested function sets only [C-modular-R1d]. The novelty status of the weight-9 relation is inconclusive [C-modular-R6a].

Open questions:

(i) Is the relation at each weight provable, for example by exact reduction of the lattice sums?

(ii) Does the generating-series counting of arXiv:2004.05156 reproduce the dimension of the weight-9 relation space [C-modular-R1d]?

(iv) Can the weight-6 relation space be determined [C-neg1]?
